answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 150026 Country: India Title: Committing some mistake in funeral prayer Question: As I prayed my grandfather’s funeral prayer, but in that I have done some mistakes while praying the dua (Allahummagfirli.....) My heart is not satisfied, I am always thinking that I have done a big mistake. I just want to know your opinion. Answer ID: 150026 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1081/1096/L=9/1438) If you forget something in the dua then your salah was valid. There is no need to worry. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
